# Elastic Web

> Intent in. The right capability out.

Elastic Web is Vedaxi's open protocol. You state an intent. It returns the capability that can do that intent, not the whole catalog.

Vedaxi is the name. Elastic Web is the product.

- Live view: https://vedaxi.com/elasticweb — demonstration. Does not book, pay, or contact anyone.
- Source: https://github.com/luxurylifestyleco/vedaxi-elastic
- Mark: https://vedaxi.com

There is no agent card on vedaxi.com. Read this file and the repository. Do not invent an endpoint.

The research-integrity desk is not Elastic Web.
